historical_reference_validation.scope: Historical source recovery and prior checks. Old assertion counts are not added to the current run.

player_feedback.whip_sound: Native CHugo action-2 sound sequence restored, including its source phase.
player_feedback.floor: Verified solid terrain supplies collision. Native water, hazards and intended openings are preserved.
player_feedback.boundaries: Two verified rear void exits have visible geometry and matching collision in both geometry modes.

camera.renderer: Godot Compatibility / Mesa llvmpipe OpenGL4.5 software
camera.body_off_draws: Diagnostic paired draws only: no physics, pose, camera, material or wall state changes between body-on/off screenshots. Gameplay never hides body or wall.
camera.body_pixel_method: max(abs(RGB difference)) >24 within projected body AABB scaled to actual pixels
camera.scope: Targeted ordinary S routes at Beach and Mines boundaries; not all possible campaign paths.

original.scene: normal spawn, idle physics, no teleport, fixed 60 Hz simulation
original.frame_metric: wall intervals; includes scheduling/rendering; not a hardware-independent FPS promise

enhanced.scene: normal spawn, idle physics, no teleport, fixed 60 Hz simulation
enhanced.frame_metric: wall intervals; includes scheduling/rendering; not a hardware-independent FPS promise

performance.note: Headless CPU and wall intervals of one normal idle spawn. Not Windows or hardware GPU FPS at 1080p/4K.

dlss5.backend: GITC-Uplift 1.8.0 / external ReShade OpenGL to D3D12 DLSS-NR

windows_export.verification_method: PE/PCK inspection and isolated execution of embedded resources with matching Linux Godot; no Windows binary execution.

limits: All eight chapters load and their bindings are audited; a continuous manual completion of all eight is not established.
CPU measurements, software OpenGL captures and Windows PE/PCK integrity do not establish performance on a particular graphics card.
Windows driver, ANGLE and neural presentation paths require execution on the target Windows machine.
The camera route and support checks cover their documented locations and inputs, not every jump, platform state or map edge.
Texture coverage, watertight shell checks and representative visual reviews are different tests; none is a universal artistic-quality guarantee.
Source movement equations and timings are retained, while Godot resolves contacts; bit-exact legacy collision ordering is not claimed.
The 16 verified voice editions are included; separate Brazilian Portuguese and Hebrew dubbing is not established by the collected sources.
Four intro_a transcodes omit the last duplicate video frame by about 60 ms; original audio remains complete.

floor_contact_separation.scope: Grounded sideways overlap with a moving native actor proxy whose recovery would push the player below existing terrain.

accepted_gpu_proof.stage: before independent small-step and walkable-tangent additions; preserved earlier proof

boundary_seam.scope: Real physics/input on two verified visible non-gameplay borders, lateral motion then away and return. No teleports, inferred all-map playthrough or performance benchmark.

old_save_position.instruction: If Continue restores a position already saved below terrain by an older build, restart that chapter through Chapters; this resets the current chapter run.

ground_tangent.problem: A horizontal command stalled at a shared edge of two real walkable Beach sand triangles before reaching the camera endpoint.
